rules.title: Use the Lumora palette
rules.rule: Campaign creatives use the Lumora palette (Teal #12917F, Navy #1B2A4E, Deep Navy #0D1A31, Mint #3FD0B6, Soft Teal #E8F6F2, Paper #F7F5F0) plus white, black and greys. No more than 3% of an image may use another colour.

rules.title: Text must be readable
rules.rule: Text in an image needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background (WCAG 2.1 AA), so everyone can read it.
